✨ What an unforgettable moment at the Tesla Takeover by @TeslaClubAT!

@mayemusk graced the stage with her signature grace and wisdom, sharing insights from her upcoming book Timeless and her extraordinary life story. 

A registered dietitian with two master’s degrees, a trailblazing supermodel for over five decades, single mother who raised three remarkable children while overcoming immense challenges — Maye proves that reinvention, resilience, and timeless elegance have no expiration date.

Her journey is pure inspiration: never too late to start over, chase new dreams, or redefine success on your own terms. Thank you, Maye, for showing the world what’s possible at any age! 💫

Preorder her book here.

UPDATE: Despite years of predictions that 𝕏 would lose relevance, new data shows the platform grew its U.S. unique visitor base between June 2025 and March 2026.

At the same time, several competing social platforms experienced notable declines in traffic.

The numbers suggest that user attention remains firmly concentrated on real-time conversations, breaking news and creator content.

In the end, people vote with their time — and millions continue choosing 𝕏 every day.

What an amazing @Tesla Takeover Europe 2026 event, so before I head off to my next stop on my trip, I thought a snapshots review of the two days was definitely in order.

So many great people, displays, events, speakers & discussion panels, light show, and I loved the local themed activities and the wonderful valley with hills and snow-capped mountains where the event took place. And, of course the great memories!

Thank you to all the members and staff from the  @TeslaClubAT and @teslaownersSV John Stringer, the venders and sponsors, and of course all @Tesla owners who came out to enjoy and support y this event! Wundebar!
